name: Kabook Daily Coupon Hunt
author: Afshari

sections.description:
Turn your website into a daily treasure hunt! Kabook Daily Coupon Hunt is not just another coupon plugin; it’s a powerful marketing and SEO tool designed to dramatically increase user engagement. By automatically generating a daily coupon and hiding it within a random selection of your articles or products, you give your visitors a thrilling reason to explore your website every single day.

🔥 Why This Plugin is an SEO Game-Changer:
When users hunt for today’s hidden coupon, they visit more pages and spend significantly more time on your site. This increased Dwell Time and lower Bounce Rate send massive positive signals to Google, naturally boosting your search engine rankings!

🚀 Core Features & Marketing Power:

  • The Daily Treasure Hunt: Automatically creates a unique coupon every midnight and places it on a random set of posts/products.
  • Dynamic Daily Discounts: Set a Minimum (e.g., 10%) and Maximum (e.g., 40%) discount range. The plugin randomly picks a percentage each day, keeping users excited and guessing!
  • FOMO & Usage Limits: Create urgency by setting a daily usage limit (e.g., “Only the first 5 users get this discount!”).
  • Individual Use Lock: Prevent users from combining this massive daily discount with other WooCommerce coupons.
  • Pro Admin Dashboard & Radar: A stunning, AJAX-powered admin panel featuring a dedicated “Status & Report” tab. See exactly which code is active, today’s randomized percentage, database stats, and a paginated list of the exact posts hiding the coupon—all at a glance.
  • Manual Trigger Button: Instantly delete today’s coupon and generate a fresh one with a single click (perfect for testing or flash sales).

🎨 Design & User Experience:

  • Copy-to-Clipboard Magic: Users can copy the coupon code with a single click, accompanied by a beautiful JavaScript toast notification.
  • 3 Stunning Visual Styles:
    • Default: Clean, minimalistic, and fast.
    • Modern: Contemporary design with solid borders.
    • Luxury: Eye-catching gradient backgrounds (fully customizable colors) designed to maximize click-through rates.
  • Smart Calendar System: Fully supports the standard WP Gregorian calendar, plus built-in native support for the Jalali (Persian) calendar.
  • Fully Customizable Text: Translate or change every single word the user sees (success messages, failure warnings, remaining limits, etc.).

⚡ Extreme Performance:
Worried about random queries slowing down your site? Don’t be! Kabook Daily Coupon Hunt uses highly optimized, transient-cached native WordPress queries. It calculates the random targets only once a day (or when manually triggered) and caches the results, completely bypassing heavy ORDER BY RAND() database loads to ensure your site remains lightning fast.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kabook-daily-coupon-hunt folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Kabook Coupon in your WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure your minimum/maximum discount, choose your design, and start your daily treasure hunt!
sections.faq:
Will the “Random Post” query slow down my high-traffic website?

Absolutely not. Unlike poorly coded plugins that use WP_Query with orderby=rand on every page load, Kabook Daily Coupon Hunt calculates the random list ONLY once a day. The results are safely stored using the WordPress Transients API, meaning zero performance hit for your visitors.

How does this plugin improve my SEO?

By announcing that a high-value coupon is hidden somewhere in your blog or shop, users will click through multiple pages to find it. This increases your Pageviews per Session and Dwell Time, both of which are critical ranking factors for search engines.

Can I test the coupon generation without waiting for tomorrow?

Yes! We’ve included a “Manual Trigger” button at the top of the settings page. One click will instantly regenerate the coupon and assign it to new random posts.

What happens if someone tries to use the coupon after the daily limit is reached?

The plugin will display your custom “Failure Text” (e.g., “Daily limit reached! Come back tomorrow for a new code.”) instead of showing the coupon box, keeping the experience smooth and transparent.

Do I need a translation plugin for the dates?

No. The plugin uses your standard WordPress date settings. If you need the Jalali (Persian) calendar, it has a built-in standalone converter—no extra plugins required!
